## JobCairn 0.3.1

A fix for Find jobs on SEEK.

### Updating
From 0.2.0 or 0.3.0: click the version number in the sidebar, then **Restart**. Your workspace isn't affected.

### Fixed
- **Find jobs on SEEK works again with filters.** When a search used a work type such as full-time, SEEK moved to a new address that JobCairn didn't recognise, so it closed the tab and found no jobs.

Everything new in 0.3.0 is in the [0.3.0 notes](https://github.com/JobCairn/jobcairn/releases/tag/v0.3.0).

### Download
- **Apple silicon (M1 or later):** `JobCairn-0.3.1-arm64.dmg`
- **Intel:** `JobCairn-0.3.1-x64.dmg`

Not sure which? Apple menu › About This Mac. **Chip** means Apple silicon; **Processor** means Intel.

Both are signed with an Apple Developer ID and notarised by Apple. The [install guide](https://jobcairn.github.io/install.html) has the full steps.

### Check your download
In the folder with the dmg and `SHA256SUMS.txt`:

    shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS.txt --ignore-missing

### Needs
macOS 13 (Ventura) or later, and a Claude plan that includes Claude Code.

Questions? Ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/JobCairn/jobcairn/discussions), without personal details.

If JobCairn helps, please ⭐ star the repo. It helps others find it.
